title: Germany news: Merz in Asia warns against weaponizing trade
summary: German diplomacy in Asia takes focus this week, as Chancellor Merz wraps up a three-country Asian business tour in South Korea. Meanwhile, President Steinmeier is set to hold talks with Xi Jinping.…

image.caption: Merz visited the Joint Security Area at the DMZ that divides North and South KoreaImage: Kay Nietfeld/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Chinese President Xi lauds 'new chapter' of German-China ties

blocks.caption: Unlike in China, the German president is a ceremonial role, but it offers an avenue for diplomacy Image: Katharina Kausche/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Ahead of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier lauded China's role as a global technological and economic power, while emphasizing the responsibility that comes along with it.
"We both bear responsibility for the ⁠international order ​and for the conditions under which states in this world maintain and shape their relations," Steinmeier said.
President Xi praised what he called an "all-dimensional strategic partnership" between China and Germany, calling for new cooperation based on stability and mutual benefit.

"This new paradigm sends a positive signal to the world: we favour openness over closure, and cooperation over confrontation," Xi said during opening remarks, emphasizing the start of a "new chapter" in Germany-China ties.
